metadata.cpu_model: AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor (KVM guest exposes 5 CPUs)
metadata.synthetic_scope: Independent identical fixture instances; each uses organism811 and an independent memory bank/topology; one immutable compiled slot is shared for CPU encoding. Not live resident gameplay.
metadata.method: Each variant warms3cohorts; 5paired samples per process, each averaging3cohorts; alternates before/after sample order. 3independent processes, second after-first. Summary median pools15samples per variant. Same linked production library provides legacy and prepared variants.
metadata.phase_scope: Prepared recall+cognitive context already built. Legacy clone+finalize+explicit finalized guard+existing attention evidence vs strict prepared attention evidence. Recall/context attachment excluded.
metadata.chain_scope: Fresh baseline/routed recall, cognitive context, attention salience/familiarity/selection, focus routing/reindex+remembered novelty, projection, finalization/full guard, CPU perception+memory upload and receptor binding. Uses exact private app helper extraction. Fixed receptor input, default predictor, 1concept+1gap, 2objects, focal_capacity1.
metadata.excluded: World/perception derivation, physiology/receptor derivation, phenotype policy lookup, resident hysteresis/history mutation, runtime admission/resident checks, sleep/lifecycle/sealing/persistence, GPU neural dispatch/readback/learning/synchronization, animation/presentation/rendering.
metadata.proof_scope: Every instance compared before/after full typed result and literal memory words, including final candidate keys/receipts/cognitive context. Perception equality is exact integer payload equality. Outside clocks. Representative complete source/frame/context/bank/topology serialization BLAKE3 hash plus9deduplicated payload word counts and little-endian-byte SHA256 digests, identical across all cohorts/processes. Full words are reproducible from the committed probe and were retained in temporary JSONL during verification.
metadata.timing_preparation: No Cargo/rustc commands from this task or its read-only reviewer overlapped timed probes; no device was opened. Shared virtual host isolation is not guaranteed.
